title.narrative: EU Support to Youth Employability and Employment Opportunities in the Cross-border area – Your Job

description.narrative: The project plans to increase employability of vulnerable young women/men through professional orientation, quality career guidance, first work experience and entrepreneurship practice. This effort will include professional orientation and information on self-employment, career guidance and individual support, skills training, first work experience and support in setting up a business. The project will also contribute to a strengthened dialogue between young, CSOs, companies and institutions.

On February 17 2023 training for forty people with business ideas in the process of supporting employment and selfemployment of young people was completed in Sarajevo. The training was organized within the framework of the EU project Your Job funded by the European Union to support the employability and employment opportunities of young people in the crossborder area.The participants of the training will apply the acquired knowledge in the process of preparing a business plan that they will apply for financing within the aforementioned project.176 people from the program area in BiH and Montenegro applied for the public competition for registering business ideas of which 40 were rated as high quality and the applicants were invited to participate in a threeday training on the incubation of business ideas.
